brief:
A mosque in the northern Israeli village of Dahi was set on fire in an overnight arson attack, according to Middle East Eye. Hebrew graffiti found on nearby walls demanded revenge for the death of a West Bank settler, suggesting a motive linked to recent tensions in the occupied territories.

The incident marked another attack on Palestinian religious sites amid escalating violence between Israeli settlers and Palestinians in the West Bank and surrounding areas.
